items.title: George Shearing interviewed by Joe Williams, New York City, New York, March 8, 1996
items.q: they would play the music for people like the Miller Brothers and Lois

ctx.x: When they’d play those shout things they’d all the front line stand up and — a great show band.

Oh, man, they would play the music for people like the Miller Brothers and Lois, and what is that, the tap dancing teams, and for ballroom danc--. They played everything absolutely elegant. What was that thing they played [scats].
